What is the reference period or as-of date on unemployment rate in British Columbia, 2025-12 (seasonally adjusted)?
response_text:
**Reference period: December 2025** (`REF_DATE = "2025-12"`) — a monthly reference period, not a point-in-time snapshot.

From the row:

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| REF_DATE | 2025-12 |
| Characteristic | Unemployment rate |
| Geography | British Columbia (DGUID 2021A000259) |
| Data type | Seasonally adjusted |
| Value | 6.3 percent (SE 0.3) |
| Vector | v2064705 |

Two caveats worth stating explicitly:

- **The file carries only month-level granularity.** Everything in it — `REF_DATE`, the coordinate, the vector — resolves to December 2025. There is no day-level as-of date in the data.
- **Underlying LFS collection is a reference *week*, not the whole month.** Statistics Canada's Labour Force Survey convention is the week containing the 15th, which for December 2025 is **Dec 14–20, 2025**. That's the actual measurement window behind the 6.3%, but it is a property of the LFS methodology, not something this extract states. If you need it as a provenance field, source it to the LFS documentation rather than to this CSV.

Also note the seasonally adjusted series is subject to revision — the December 2025 value is as-published in this extract, and the extract has no publication/release-date column to pin which vintage it is.
